The US requested an emergency meeting of the [United Nations Security Council](/wiki/United_Nations_Security_Council "United Nations Security Council") on 25 October and Ambassador to the United Nations, Adlai Stevenson, confronted Soviet Ambassador [Valerian Zorin](/wiki/Valerian_Zorin "Valerian Zorin") and challenged him to admit the existence of the missiles. Ambassador Zorin refused to answer. At 10:00 pm EDT the next day, the US raised the readiness level of [Strategic Air Command](/wiki/Strategic_Air_Command "Strategic Air Command") (SAC) forces to DEFCON 2. For the only confirmed time in US history, [B-52](/wiki/Boeing_B-52_Stratofortress "Boeing B-52 Stratofortress") bombers were put on continuous airborne alert. [B-47](/wiki/Boeing_B-47_Stratojet "Boeing B-47 Stratojet") medium bombers were dispersed to military and civilian airfields and made ready to take off, fully equipped, at 15 minutes' notice.[[123]](#cite_note-123) One-eighth of SAC's 1,436 bombers were on airborne alert. The government of Vatican City has a unique structure. As governed by the Holy See, the pope is the sovereign of the state, but he is supported by different bodies. Legislative authority is managed, in the pope's name, by the [Pontifical Commission for Vatican City State](/wiki/Pontifical_Commission_for_Vatican_City_State "Pontifical Commission for Vatican City State"), a body of cardinals appointed by the pope for five-year periods. Executive power is exercised by the [president of that commission](/wiki/President_of_the_Pontifical_Commission_for_Vatican_City_State "President of the Pontifical Commission for Vatican City State"), who is consequently also the president of the governorate, assisted by the general secretary and the deputy general secretary.[[71]](#cite_note-83)[[72]](#cite_note-84) The state's foreign relations are entrusted to the Holy See's [Secretariat of State](/wiki/Secretariat_of_State_(Holy_See) "Secretariat of State (Holy See)") and diplomatic service.

Nevertheless, the pope has absolute power in the executive, legislative, and judicial branches over Vatican City,[[73]](#cite_note-Vatican_City-85)
and is thus the only [absolute monarch](/wiki/Absolute_monarchy "Absolute monarchy") in Europe.[[74]](#cite_note-86)

Operationally, there are departments that deal with health, security, telecommunications and other matters.[[73]](#cite_note-Vatican_City-85)

Texas is the southernmost part of the Great Plains, which ends in the south against the folded [Sierra Madre Occidental](/wiki/Sierra_Madre_Occidental "Sierra Madre Occidental") of Mexico. The [continental crust](/wiki/Continental_crust "Continental crust") forms a stable [Mesoproterozoic](/wiki/Mesoproterozoic "Mesoproterozoic") [craton](/wiki/Craton "Craton") which changes across a broad continental margin and transitional crust into true [oceanic crust](/wiki/Oceanic_crust "Oceanic crust") of the Gulf of Mexico. The oldest rocks in Texas date from the Mesoproterozoic and are about 1,600 million years old.[[150]](#cite_note-155)

The margin created by the continental crust existed until [Laurasia](/wiki/Laurasia "Laurasia") and [Gondwana](/wiki/Gondwana "Gondwana") collided in the [Pennsylvanian](/wiki/Pennsylvanian_(geology) "Pennsylvanian (geology)") subperiod to form [Pangea](/wiki/Pangea "Pangea").[[151]](#cite_note-156) Pangea began to break up in the [Triassic](/wiki/Triassic "Triassic"), but [seafloor spreading](/wiki/Seafloor_spreading "Seafloor spreading") to form the Gulf of Mexico occurred only in the mid- and [late Jurassic](/wiki/Late_Jurassic "Late Jurassic"). Tranströmer was born in [Stockholm](/wiki/Stockholm "Stockholm") in 1931 and raised by his mother Helmy, a schoolteacher, following her divorce from his father, Gösta Tranströmer, an editor.[[5]](#cite_note-ap_nobel-5)[[6]](#cite_note-Lea_Flood_2011-6) He received his secondary education at the [Södra Latin](/wiki/S%C3%B6dra_Latin "Södra Latin") [Gymnasium](/wiki/Gymnasium_(school) "Gymnasium (school)") in Stockholm, where he began writing poetry. In addition to selected journal publications, his first collection of poems, *[17 Poems](/wiki/17_Poems "17 Poems")*, was published in 1954. He continued his education at [Stockholm University](/wiki/Stockholm_University "Stockholm University"), graduating as a psychologist in 1956 with additional studies in history, religion and literature.[[7]](#cite_note-wp_nobel-7) Between 1960 and 1966, Tranströmer split his time between working as a psychologist at the [Roxtuna centre for juvenile delinquents](/w/index.php?title=Anstalten_Roxtuna&action=edit&redlink=1 "Anstalten Roxtuna (page does not exist)") and writing poetry.[[5]](#cite_note-ap_nobel-5) He worked as a psychologist at the Labor Market Institute in [Västerås](/wiki/V%C3%A4ster%C3%A5s "Västerås") from 1965 to 1990.[[8]](#cite_note-8)
